function.name: search_codebase
function.description: Incremental workspace code search: semantic versioned vectors, exact literal text, or exact symbol name. Approximate LSH candidates are explicitly labeled; ignores and secrets are excluded. Remote backfill is explicit.

query.description: Natural language query, e.g., 'where is the login logic' or 'database initialization'

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 5)
